svg.title: Toolbox
svg.desc: Languages: Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, SQL, Bash, C++, R, Julia; LLMs & Model APIs: Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, Llama, Mistral, Ollama, Groq, vLLM; Agents & Orchestration: LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, MCP, Pydantic, n8n, Zapier; RAG & Vector Search: pgvector, Supabase, Pinecone, Qdrant, Redis, Elasticsearch, Neo4j, Kafka; Training & Deep Learning: PyTorch, Transformers, TensorFlow, Keras, scikit-learn, CUDA, ONNX, W&B; Serving & LLMOps: FastAPI, Docker, Gradio, Streamlit, MLflow, GitHub Actions, Vercel, Google Cloud
